metadata.title: Signs Someone Is Controlling You (Dark Psychology) #Shorts
metadata.description: Covert controllers use these exact moves on people every day. Spot them in seconds. Which one have you seen? #Shorts #DarkPsychology #Manipulation

audio_profile.recommended_voice_style: deep male authoritative, protective and serious
audio_profile.bg_music_vibe: cinematic tension strings with dark ambient swell

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Controllers follow a script. Learn these four moves before someone runs them on you.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: puppet strings hands dark background dramatic macro

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Move one. Gaslighting. They rewrite events until you doubt your own mind.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: broken mirror fragments reflection face dark moody macro

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: You remember it clearly. They insist it never happened. Always trust the recording.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: voice recorder phone notes dim room moody cinematic

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Move two. Love bombing. Overwhelming kindness first. Control arrives later.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: red roses bouquet dark velvet dramatic cinematic macro

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Real affection stays consistent. Bombs are timed. Watch what happens after you disagree.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: rose petals falling dark water slow motion cinematic

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Move three. Isolation. They cut your circle. One friend at a time.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: lonely person empty bench park fog dusk moody cinematic

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Move four. Silent treatment. Punishment through absence. Designed to break you.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: empty room single phone glowing dark moody cinematic

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Now you see the script. Share this with someone who needs it. Follow for more.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: sunrise breaking through dark clouds hopeful cinematic wide
